notes.title: Releasing for the Switch, PS5, and Xbox on February 6!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=w4D45zplAPc;full][/previewyoutube]
An ominous bell rings near the village of Koho...

The sound of the bell attracts demons, who threaten to invade the village. Momo Reinol, Koho's most capable priestess, is sent to investigate the bell toll and protect the village, and most importantly, the sacred Lun Tree...

The game's lore-rich world is depicted in gorgeous pixel art and animation. Fight unique enemies with melee combos, well-timed dodges, and skillful archery. Use various "Sigils" hidden across the map to freely customize your play style. Defeat threatening bosses that stand in your way and save the village from destruction.

Momodora: Moonlit Farewell is the newest entry in the Momodora series of Metroidvanias that began in 2010, and will be coming to the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S on February 6.

We hope you'll enjoy playing Momodora: Moonlit Farewell on consoles too!

notes.title: We were Awarded Best Game: Brazil at BIG Festival!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Momodora: Moonlit Farewell.

We're proud to announce that Momodora: Moonlit Farewell has been awarded Best Game: Brazil at BIG Festival (Best International Games Festival), currently underway at gamescom latam!

It's all thanks to your support that we could receive this award!
We've received a message from rdein, the developer:

-----
Hello everyone!
This is rdein, director of Momodora: Moonlit Farewell. I come to share the news of our win in the "Best Game: Brazil" category from BIG Festival, held at gamescom latam! 
This is an incredible honor for us. We'd never have gotten this far, the 5th Momodora episode, without the unending support of our fans.
I'd like to give a shout out to those who have helped me create the series and lead it this far. So I'd like to thank PKBT, Gavin, Elektrobear, Thernz, Hammu, Temmie, Koyorin, Paul, Cyn, our publisher partners, my family, and Coco and Mona.

I sincerely hope those who have played the Momodora series so far have enjoyed it. And if you have yet to try it, Iit is my wish that you have a pleasant journey!

Thank you so much again, and see you next time!
-----

If you already own Momodora: Reverie Under The Moonlight, you can purchase the Momodora Collection bundle to get Moonlit Farewell at 10% off.
Don't miss out!

notes.title: Ver. 1.1 Major Contents Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Momodora: Moonlit Farewell.
Today, we have updated to Ver. 1.1, adding multiple new features.

New boss battle
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/0a4662a4348fa505f1da45601587b053e31321a4.png
An entirely new boss battle is now available to those who finished the main story. You can experience it by talking to Dora at Koho Village! Be ready for a challenge!

New Boss rush mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/edf1daf0718ac666dedb84dcddab10f509bc53ff.png
After spending some time at the Last Layer, players will be able to meet a new character, a magi called Patata. Through her you will be able to challenge a new "Wanderlust" boss rush involving every boss encounter in one single sequence.

Revised dialogue and UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/919ca3cc6a1d80147188e0b2134f4ec25f8a9684.png
A small revision was made to the story cutscenes near the end of Meikan Village.

Additionally, an entirely new dialogue scene has been added to further expand on Dora's story and thoughts. This new scene can be accessed at any moment at Meikan Village, even if you've already seen the credits.

The companions menu now displays a brief description of what each type does.

Expanded Fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41832743/5748f970908f541f83fb7290eacd5684ebc2a623.png
A fishing menu has been added to the game to keep a record of the amount of times each fish has been caught. Since this is a new addition, it does not keep track of fishes caught previous to this update. (Sorry!)

New fishes have been added to the game. Rarer fishes have been regionalized, making them only available at specific fishing holes.

Patch Notes

A new boss battle is now available after watching the credits
A new boss rush mode has been added to The Last Layer, available after some progress is made in the zone
Added some dialogue to a cutscene at the end of Meikan Village
Added an entire new scene at the end of Meikan Village
A fishing log has been added
New fishes have been added
Rarer fishes have been regionalized, making them only available at specific fishing holes
The companions menu now displays a brief description of what each type does
A new save point was added to the room with the matriarch
Added new tutorials during the Koho Village segment in the early game
Two new inventory items have been added
The invincibility period once the Glazed Aegis shield breaks has been adjusted to match more closely the invincibility period length when getting hit normally
Fixed an issue where some dead fairies would still remain after Sorrelia is defeated
Fixed an issue where the player could go out of bounds during the fight against Plunia at the Last Layer
Fixed typos

If you haven't picked up the game yet, this is the perfect time to do so.
We hope you continue to enjoy Momodora: Moonlit Farewell!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37197/Momodora/

This is the culmination of the Momodora series, and takes place 5 years after the events of Momodora III. Momo, a high priestess of Koho Village, is tasked to set off on a journey to save the world from demons, who were summoned by the ringing of a mysterious bell.

Explore an enchanting pixel art world with flashy attacks and other skills such as melee combos, dodging, and ranged attacks.

By activating "Sigils", you can strengthen your attack or your healing, or even summon magic swords to smite your enemies. After you obtain a Sigil, you can activate or deactivate it whenever you like, so you can swap them on the run and customize your abilities to match your playstyle.
